import csv
cool='3ec6613e-4d87-5159-ac83-7852e7c94984'
heat='73f7a82c-2e72-5d4e-90c0-8e6bbf10cc51'
temp='be41bf6b-c1ca-5cc0-a271-2cd4fca56654'
data={cool:{},heat:{},temp:{}}
with open(VALUES_CSV) as f:
    r=csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in r:
        tid=row['timeseries_id']
        if tid in data and row['timestamp'].startswith('2018-07-16'):
            data[tid][row['timestamp']]=float(row['value'])
print('counts', {k:len(v) for k,v in data.items()})
ts=sorted(data[temp].keys())
print(ts)
out=0
for t in ts:
    T=data[temp].get(t); C=data[cool].get(t); H=data[heat].get(t)
    out_flag = (H is not None and T<H) or (C is not None and T>C)
    if out_flag: out+=1
    print(t,T,H,C,out_flag)
print('outside count', out)
